text:
emma: quick sync — exec asked for a crisp slide on geo tradeoffs: customers are asking for stronger tenant isolation across regions but they won’t sign up for a 2x reserved spend. need a clear recommendation by Fri. who can own tradeoffs?

sanjay: i can sketch options. two axes: isolation guarantee (soft tenancy vs strict region locks) and cost model (shared infra vs dedicated pools).

kai: +1. also add operational risk: cross-region failover increases blast radius if we don't pin KV caches.

olivia: from sales — several enterprise POCs asked for "regional data bounds" + latency SLO. they prefer deterministic SLA over best-effort. most will accept soft isolation if we promise latency 99th p95 targets.

nora: important to separate asks: (1) compliance/data residency (hard boundary), (2) performance affinity (latency), (3) tenancy blast radius (isolation). customers conflate them.

emma: good call. can we produce 3 recommended packages for the exec slide: pragmatic, balanced, and conservative? pragmatic = shared infra + routing policies; balanced = regional reservation + soft pinning; conservative = hard tenant pools per region. include cost delta estimates.

sanjay: rough sketch: pragmatic: 0% commit uplift, balanced: ~1.3x cost for peak isolation, conservative: ~1.9–2.2x. numbers depend on tail load and cold-starts.

kai: and ops complexity: pragmatic low, balanced medium (autoscaler rules + affinity anchors), conservative high (separate fleets + network isolation). add rollout risk per approach.

olivia: add customer mapping column: small SaaS customers -> pragmatic; mid-market w/ latency SLAs -> balanced; regulated enterprises -> conservative.

emma: can someone draft the slide content + one-sentence recommendation? i'd prefer to recommend balanced as default with canary customers on conservative plan.

sanjay: will draft. propose we include a short example routing policy i expect infra to implement.

kai: paste below sample of what the routing policy could look like (informal):

```
route: {
  priority: ["regional-pin", "latency-sla", "cost-fallback"],
  regional-pin: { enabled: true, ttl: 300 },
  cost-fallback: { allow_cross_region: true, max_token_cost: 0.8 }
}
```

kai: that lets us prefer regional slices but fall back to cross-region if capacity/cost thresholds hit.

nora: include launch criteria for balanced: (A) autoscaler + affinity anchors tested in staging, (B) latency telemetry per-tenant in console, (C) cost delta < 1.5x for 90% of customers in pilot.

emma: perfect. olivia, can you surface 2 customer quotes to the deck? we should call out the top two compliance asks.

olivia: i'll get them today.

emma: timeline: sanjay drafts slide today, kai adds the sample policy and rollout risks, nora writes launch criteria, olivia gets customer quotes. i'll consolidate and send to execs by Thu EOD.

deploy-bot: reminder: planning meeting scheduled Thu 16:00 UTC — calendar invite sent. :calendar: 

olivia: :thumbsup: thanks all.

emma: great — thanks team. we'll reconvene after Thu planning to lock decision. :rocket:
